(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7

I hereby give notice, under Sub - Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude for public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: The allotments of land depicted in Sheet No. 1, Block No. 01, in the Cadastral Map No. 321032 and dated 30.12.2024, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Kadiyanlena, in Kadiyanlena Grama Niladhari Division No. 1081, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Pasbage Korale in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows : Boundaries of the land Bowhill Estate Lot No. 1 in total extent of about 1.1665 Hectares. North by : Baharanda Oya and Lot No. 1 in P. P. Maha 1849; East By : Lot No. 1 in P. P. Maha 1849; South by : Lot No. 1 in P. P. Maha 1849; West by : Baharanda Oya. Boundaries of the land Bowhill Estate Lot No. 2 in total extent of about 0.0190 Hectare.

North by : Lot No. 1 in P. P. Maha 1849 and Baharanda Oya; East by : Baharanda Oya; South by : Baharanda Oya and Lot No. 1 in P. P. Maha 1849; West by : Lot No. 1 in P. P. Maha 1849 All persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid land/servitude hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me on 03.04.2025 at 9.00 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat, Pasbage Korale Nawalapitiya. And further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing in duplicate before 30.03.2025 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. J. M. Rൺආඒൺ Jൺඒൺඌඎඇൽൺඋൺ, Divisional Secretary, Pasbage Korale. At the Divisional Secretariat, Pasbage Korale, On the 24th day of January, 2025.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7

I hereby give notice, under Sub - Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose. Public Purpose: Acquisition of land for granting alternative lands for those who were displaced due to floods. An allotment of land called "Maha Dabetanna" in to extent of about 0.4092 Hectare depicted as Lots 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 in the Cadastral Plan No. 710462 Zonal No. 01 and Sheet No. 01 date 14.10.2024 prepared by Survey General situated in the Village called Maha Dabetanna of the Grama Niladhari Division No. 63 of Dabetanna in Maha Palatha Korale Minor Division of the Divisional Secretary's Division of Haputale in Badulla District of the Uva Province and morefully described as follows : SCHEDULE 01.
